order: three letters = storage / feeder load multiplier / PV irradiance
source: one reset native Simulink plus two native IEEE34 per complete group; same delivered-gate, +28 kW event and sampling; original group-specific imports are subtracted at interface, fixed DSS voltages

gates.audit: independent same-state neutral/winner restart for all selected power labels; validate every fast step, same-reach H10 prefixes; each group, condition and source digest belongs to exactly one split

audit.primary: power MAE; arrival-to-request MAE on mutually witnessed claims plus false/missed arrivals; certified duration class 0/2/5/10; 5-to-10 overclaim; frequency/size of power overclaim against finite witness, actual native violations separately; metrics also grouped by complete condition
audit.selection: freeze architecture and updates; both raw and validation-only conservative derating: smallest adjustment meeting overpromise fraction threshold, else smallest fraction then smallest offset; held-out decisions once
audit.scope: no extrapolation proof, no additional sweeps
